text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“—When people speak of an unforgettable 
generation, which Umamusume come to your 
mind?”

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"The Eternal Big Three. BNW. The Golden 
Generation. Many Umamusume have 
brilliantly colored each era throughout 
history."

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“Now, the ones we're introducing this time 
are none other than the dazzling four 
stars currently lighting up the Twinkle 
Series—”

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Got a second—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ah... Were you watching TV?
choice_data_list: No, I'm fine. Did something happen?
No, I'm fine. Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: We received a request for a tandem run.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Umm—
Oooooh, pleeeease teach meeee!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me, I-I... my growth spurt, 
well, came much later than everyone 
else's... So I couldn't run in the Classic 
Triple Crown...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-That's why...! But still! F-From now on! 
I want to run with you so, so much, 
Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I just wanted to run... so much.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
S-So... umm, umm... well. Is it... not 
okay...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to run more with you, too. 
That's what I feel."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's why...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's not... a no. ...Is that fine? 
Trainer.

And so, I headed to the grounds together 
with Meisho Doto—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh...? Um, excuse me, that person over 
there radiating a dazzling, silent 
presence... Could it be...?!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...What are you doing over there, Opera O?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!! Did someone call for me!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, should I hide instead of 
replying? As a joke—or perhaps to keep 
from collapsing out of sheer joy from 
seeing them!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"You came marching all the way over here, 
and now you're hesitating...?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—Let's run. I'll run too. Let's run 
together! Through the Junior, Classic, and 
Senior Class, and forever beyond that!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To be able to spend three years—and even 
more time— together with you brings me a 
joy beyond words, Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I suppose so—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Piercing the back of the haughty Conqueror 
of the End of the Century... is reasonably 
fun, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha! Now then, can you manage a late 
surge? Give it your best shot, my 
first-magnitude star!

And so, with T.M. Opera O joining in, as 
we finished our warm-up exercises—

Ah! Could it be that everyone is about to 
do tandem training together...!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Oh! Hahaha, this voice is—!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Um, it's about time to start, right? Would 
it be too much trouble... to add something 
at this point...?!

Even so, with "I want to run!" written all 
over Narita Top Road's face, I just smiled 
back at her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...You too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Because! If I can run with Ayabe-san and 
the others, I don't want to miss the 
chance...!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I've decided to stubbornly cling on and 
see it through. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Besides...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—Because I don't want to lose. Of course 
for my own sake, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Because I want 'us' to keep winning 
together!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Let's run, Ayabe-san! I won't lose, not to 
you!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...That's my line.

And so—they watched brightly as the four 
backs dashed vigorously ahead.

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"T.M. Opera O. Meisho Doto. Narita Top 
Road. And—Admire Vega."

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"‘The four stars that continue to shine 
upon the turf shall surely illuminate this 
era brilliantly for years to come—’"

Wishing that the profile of her sprinting
